summary: Collective Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting issuance of an unsecured promissory note for up to $500,000 to its sponsor, Collective Acquisition Sponsor LLC, to fund costs related to a business combination. The note carries no interest, due upon consummation or winding-up, repayable only from funds outside the trust account. The sponsor may convert outstanding principal into private placement warrants at $1.00 per warrant pre-maturity. The filing signals continued SPAC operations and an ongoing search for a target. Watch for announcement of a definitive business combination agreement as the October 2026 deadline approaches, with risk-arb focus on deal terms and shareholder redemption risk.
